Kalaiyarasan vs The Commissioner on 5 March, 2024 
Author: G.R.Swaminathan Bench: G.R.Swaminathan  W.P(
 BEFORE THE MADURAI BENCH OF MADRAS HIGH COURT  DATED : 05.03.2024  CORAM  THE HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE G.R.SWAMINATHAN  W.P(MD)No.4192 of 2024  and  W.M.P.(MD)Nos.4045, 4048 & 4049 of 20224  Kalaiyarasan   Vs.
 1.The Commissioner,
 Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug,
 Administration Department,
 DMS Campus, 5th Floor,
 No.359 Annasalai, Teynampet,
 Chennai 600 006.
 2.The Designated Officer,
 Tamil Nadu Food Safety and  Drug Administration Department,
 Food Safety Wing,
 Trichy District. ...
 Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In  praying this Court to issue a Writ of Certiorari, to call f  pertaining to the impugned notice issued in  3087/Vu.Pa.Thu/Trichy/2023 dated NIL passed by the 2nd respondent and  quash the same as illegal and unconstitutional. 
 For Petitioners : Mr.B.Jameelarasu  For Respondents : Mr.T.Villavankothai  Additional Government Pleader https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  1/2  W.P(MD)N Kalaiyarasan vs The Commissioner on 5 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24551105/
1  G.R.SWAMINATHAN, 
 
 ORDER The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks leave to withdraw the writ petition. 
2. In view of the above, the Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently,
connected miscellaneous petitions are closed. 
 05.03.
